# COLOR table

3,028 bytes: 12 records of 28 bytes, four u32 LUTs, six u16 LUTs and a trailer.

**Category:** table · **Address:** `0x60622d74` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [pen-f firmware 3.1, build 3101](../firmware/pen-f-3101.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus PEN-F](../cameras/pen-f.md)

OES arrays and the camera wheel share one twelve-sector order; physical coefficient records use another. Saturation is stored as a gain, not the slider value.

## Observations

- **Static analysis** ([Olympus firmware research](../projects/oly-fw-analysis.md)): Layout read; a byte-identical table is in the Workspace OlyAcacia library. Source: [PEN-F HSL tables](../sources/fishcu.pen-f-hsl-tables.md).
- **Physical camera** ([Olympus firmware research](../projects/oly-fw-analysis.md)): A yellow-lightness edit changed COLOR output on the camera. Source: [PEN-F HSL tables](../sources/fishcu.pen-f-hsl-tables.md).
